concept: Weird 117 film: My First My Last comes alive (small black spiders pour out of the cracks of the artwork in a dense swarm), then everything turns into wobbling green jelly that shakes and splits, it becomes a giant mouth that eats itself, chewing and swallowing in a loop, ending on 117 made of sushi rice and salmon pieces, on a black slate plate
audio_source: original synthesized sound bed generated locally with ffmpeg (noise, drones, blips); no third-party audio
